synopsis: The booklet cites Wabtec for mining applications and describes Level 9 intervention as a machine-control capability rather than a standalone product [f15780, f2585]. Its December 2021 validation on Komatsu 730E and 860E haul trucks demonstrated controlled deceleration at speeds up to 30 km/h, with internal and customer acceptance reported [f817, f1345, f1837]. Physical testing remained primary at integration, including detection-zone adjustments for braking distance, speed, payload and haul-road grade; in 2023, Wabtec described its third-generation system as the result of multiple years of field and production testing [f1347, f15782, f818]. The cited EMESRT PR-5A requirement was reviewed and updated in September 2024 and identified in Wabtec material as Rev 3.0 [f318, f6231]. These examples do not establish a validation timetable: capability-building and subsequent validation durations were not found, and a surface-quarry comparison with Wabtec and Hexagon systems was unavailable [f1835, f2024].
